records.title: Health Insurance for Advocates
details: Part (a) and (b): The need to frame a Medical and Life Insurance Scheme for Advocates and their dependents was proposed by delegation of advocates led by Chairman of BCI to Hon’ble Union Law Minister in year 2019. Thereafter a committee comprising the representatives from BCI/State Bar Council and senior officials of Government of India was constituted by the Central Government to work out a comprehensive Medical and Life Insurance Scheme for advocates and their dependents. The Committee has sought certain details such as number of advocates to be enrolled and practicing along with data such as age, total members of family etc from the BCI. After the receipts of these details, the Insurance Companies will be in a position to offer a scheme of insurance.
